tokens.TAGLINE: simple to understand, simple to implement
tokens.VOICE_DOUBLES_HOOK: A whole new layer of motivation when you know your partner is working just as hard.
tokens.VOICE_WEDDING: the work still counts when conditions aren't perfect.
tokens.VOICE_NEWS_TAKE: Performance isn't about having perfect conditions. It's about finding a way to execute anyway.

news.title: Back to Hamburg
news.summary: Returning to a race that has always meant something, with the standard higher than ever.
news.take: We know the standard will be up there with the best. We'll fight until the last wall ball.

news.title: Training with your cycle, not beneath it
news.summary: Tracking gives context. It doesn't automatically decide what an athlete can do that day.
news.take: Use the information, assess how you feel, then make the right training decision for you.

news.title: Conditions won't always be perfect
news.summary: Wrong shoes, dead headphones, hard session. The work can still get done.
news.take: Performance isn't about waiting for the perfect environment. It's about executing anyway.
